## Classification

## Review checklist

- [ ] I identified the affected control(s) or repository area.
- [ ] I removed personal, confidential, credential, and environment-specific material.
- [ ] I preserved the distinction between policy, source-backed fact, and inference.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` and `VERSION` when the change is material.
- [ ] I added or updated acceptance criteria and evidence where needed.
- [ ] I ran the repository checks.
